map.：①剂量：每日总剂量 = 体重(kg) × 每公斤剂量(mg/kg)，每次剂量: : (1) Dosage: total daily dose = body weight (kg) x dose per kg (mg/kg), dose per time = total daily dose / doses per day. (2) Infusion: drops/min = total volume (mL) x drop factor / time (min), drops/hour = drops/min x 60, mL/h = total volume / (time / 60). (3) Blood glucose: mg/dL = mmol/L x 18.0159, mmol/L = mg/dL / 18.0159 (the tool embeds the precise factor, unlike generic conversion pages that use the approximation 18).

map.「每日总剂量 ÷ 次数」和「每次剂量 × 次数」哪种算法对？: Which formula is right, "total daily dose / number of times" or "dose per time x number of times"?
map.取决于医嘱的表述方式。若医嘱为「每日 10 mg/kg，分 3 次」，应先算日总: It depends on how the order is worded. If it says "10 mg/kg daily in 3 divided doses", compute the daily total first and then divide it equally (the path this tool uses); if it says "10 mg/kg each time, 3 times daily", the daily total is three times the per-dose amount. The two differ by a factor of 3 and are the most common source of dosing error, so always follow the order's wording; double-check especially in pediatrics.
map.滴/分取整后误差有多大？: How large is the error after rounding drops/min?
map.本例理论值 62.5 滴/分取整为 63，相对误差 0.8%。实际重力滴注中液面: Here the theoretical 62.5 drops/min rounds to 63, a relative error of 0.8%. In real gravity infusion, deviations from liquid level height, kinked tubing and patient position are far larger (often up to plus or minus 10%), so the drop count sets an initial value that must then be fine-tuned against the actual rate and rechecked regularly; use an infusion pump for narrow-therapeutic-window drugs.
